correctness.rationale: Direct local proof reduces every reduced line arrangement intersection to a squarefree homogeneous binary product, including unit invariance. In tame characteristic the two derivatives form a regular sequence. When p divides m>=3, Euler and coprimeness give F_u=vH, F_v=-uH, gcd(F,H)=1; the explicit two-column Hilbert–Burch matrix has height-two minors (F,uH,vH) and all positive-degree entries, yielding exact minimal shifts. Its Hilbert numerator and final syzygies give colength (m-1)^2 and socle type exactly 2. The p=2,m=2 boundary is separately resolved. Exact finite-field tests independently confirm six representative wild/tame Hilbert functions and equation redundancy, not the infinite quantifier.

value.rationale: The theorem determines intrinsic local Jacobian singular schemes at every point of every reduced projective line arrangement in arbitrary characteristic, with an all-multiplicity sharp criterion for Gorensteinness and a complete minimal graded resolution. Wild and tame cases have exactly the same local Tjurina lengths and Hilbert functions, so the type jump is invisible to familiar numerical and incidence invariants. The distinction matters for deformation-theoretic local Tjurina algebras and scheme-theoretic singularities, not a renamed or arbitrary finite computation.
